> getOption('repos')
                     CRAN                      RSPM

I tried to see if I had announced that at all, but couldn't find evidence that I had. My apologies.

Unfortunately, while running on custom domains is supported, shinyapps.io <http://shinyapps.io> does not support any "white label" features at this time. In other words, there is no way to change the branding on the login page.

> With respect to customer users, we don’t want them to see the following:
>
> -tokens
> -domains
> -settings
> -usage
> -billing (professional plan)

>
> - specific app (when private, seems like one profile having access to shinyapps dashboard has access to whole apps)
> - ability to archive, delete or restart apps
> - URLs

A user can be added to an account, or to a specific application. If a user is added to an account, he or she will have access to all the features you listed above for that account. When a user is added to a specific application he or she will only be able to login to that application and will not have access to the shinyapps.io <http://shinyapps.io> dashboard at all.

Hope that helps.
-Andy
